camel_example: aliyun sas ListHoneypotProbe --region cn-hangzhou --ProbeStatus online --ProbeType host_probe --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --DisplayName 'probe-test' --Lang en
description_en: Queries the list of honeypot probes
kebab_example: aliyun sas list-honeypot-probe --probe-status online --display-name probe-test --probe-type host_probe --lang en --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHoneypotProbe

parameters.help_en:
The probe status. Valid values:
installed: Installation succeeded.
install_failed: Installation failed.
online: Normal.
offline: Offline.
unnormal: Service exception.
unprobe: Unauthorized.
uninstalling: Uninstalling.
uninstalled: Uninstallation succeeded.
uninstall_failed: Uninstallation failed.
not_exist: Not installed
parameters.help_zh:
探针状态。取值：
installed：安装成功
install_failed：安装失败
online：正常
offline：离线
unnormal：服务异常
unprobe：未授权
uninstalling：卸载中
uninstalled：卸载成功
uninstall_failed：卸载失败
not_exist：未安装
parameters.name: probe_status

parameters.help_en:
The probe type. Valid values:

host_probe: host probe
vpc_black_hole_probe: VPC blackhole probe
parameters.help_zh:
探针类型。取值：

host_probe：主机探针
vpc_black_hole_probe：VPC黑洞探针
parameters.name: probe_type

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。起始值为1。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page during paging.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size
